sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 400. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Healing Ability Power 100. Heals HP.
-Target: all allies. Removes debuffs and special debuffs.
-Target: all allies. Boosts HP recovery effects by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 30 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 50 Cost.
-Target: yourself. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 60 seconds.
Boosts stats of Monsters of all elements by 20% when equipped in the Main Slot.
